| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID |
| `--ai-observations` | No | Add optional model observations. **Consumes MCPJam credits.** |
| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Replay guard |
| `--claim <feature>` | No | Declare a feature the server offers. Repeatable. See [Lazy authentication and feature claims](#lazy-a
uthentication-and-feature-claims) |
| `--lazy-auth-probe` | No | Opt in to the credential-free lazy-authentication probe |
| `--claim <feature>` | Declare a feature the server offers, so the report shows it as claimed. One of `lazy-authentication` or `e
nterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage error. |
| `--lazy-auth-probe` | Opt in to the lazy-authentication probe. The probe calls one public tool, then one protected tool, both **
without credentials**. It makes at most two calls and calls only tools annotated `readOnlyHint: true`. Without the two flags below
, it picks the tools from their `securitySchemes`. |
| `--lazy-auth-tool <name>` | The protected tool the probe calls. Implies `--lazy-auth-probe`. Up to 128 characters. |
| `--lazy-auth-public-tool <name>` | The public tool the probe calls first. Implies `--lazy-auth-probe`. Up to 128 characters, and
it must name a different tool than `--lazy-auth-tool`. |
## `cloud eval` commands
All `eval` commands accept the shared platform flags below.
### `cloud eval create`
Create a runnable eval suite from authored test cases (does not run it).
### `cloud eval list`
